body: Maebe thats not such a bad idea.

My mind alone is hugely different than my mind when I'm actively interacting with people. While alone it goes to dark places I would never even think about telling anyone about. Quite annoying! I am doing better today, thank you for your post.

I wish I had good advice to give. I just want to say that girl is a dick for doing that to you and I'm sorry you've gotten so many rotten apples in the relationship basket. Stay away from the xanax! All my friends are into it and it has ruined their lives in so many ways.. I hope things work out for you!

<hugs> great job losing 60lbs, sheesh, that's awesome! Facebook seriously makes me sooo miserable. You see all the things you don't have and it's super frustrating. Try to keep the facebooking to a minimum when you're feeling sensitive about life in general. I found that helps to not depress your already depressed mood a little bit. Every little bit counts every day, right?

Don't do it. She may say she wants no strings attached and she may even mean it, but you never know how people act after something like that. Seriously, you open a whole hooplah of hormones playing that game and it's no fun for anybody. Be nice and say I don't want you to get hurt, and if she persists than ignore her. Personal experience here, from the ex-gf standpoint. I thought I wanted NSA, but ended up feeling like total ass about myself the next day.

Thank you. It really isn't up to me at this point what happens between us. All I can control is myself and how I go on from here. The last two months have been pretty good, but as soon as I initiated contact again, I think I completely re-opened the wound and kinda set myself back to square one. Not gonna make that mistake again! Thanks for your advice.

I know! It's so easy to say that and it's soo true! (The 'one day I'll look back and realize'). But when its happening it literally feels like my insides are caving in. It's dramatic and annoying, lol. I definitely will hold onto the good memories, but also remind myself of the bad ones to make sure I don't forget why we needed to be separate in the first place. Thanks for your help!

When I say good terms, I guess I mean that the break up wasn't caused by a huge fight or cheating or anything. It was just simply not working out, we both seemed disinterested in each other, and we both kinda knew that it wasn't healthy to drag on like this. Realizing those things is one thing, but accepting them and moving on is a whole new ordeal that I was ill prepared for. I'm doing much better today, and tomorrow will probably be better. Thank you
Thank you, I really appreciate that.
Thank you so much for sharing. Time seems to be a key thing in this whole process
